The 'sales' arm goes to Delegate 'sales' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Sales Lead - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Sales Lead before relying on that arm.

behaviour.title: Set the environment variables, or inline the values
behaviour.detail: This template reads $env.ASANA_PROJECT_GID, $env.ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID. Environment variables are not exposed to expressions on n8n Cloud at all, and on self-hosted they are unset until you add them - in both cases the expression falls through to its literal fallback rather than erroring, so the call is made against a placeholder.

Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
